item.title: Barcola passed fit for Liverpool's game against Brighton
item.description: Liverpool forward Bradley Barcola is fit to face Brighton on Saturday after recovering from a hip problem, manager Andoni Iraola says.

item.title: Elliott in talks over Valencia loan move
item.description: Liverpool midfielder Harvey Elliott is in talks over a loan move to Valencia in January, with the Spanish side agreeing terms with the player.

item.title: Klopp: Jota biography a fitting tribute
item.description: Former Liverpool manager Jurgen Klopp says a new biography of Diogo Jota, with proceeds going to charity, is a fitting tribute to the late forward.
